column1: # played_line_vectors.tsv — ONE case table for the played line's two decisions (METERLINE), and for
# what R(t) reads while the line is followed (line_realm, INTEG item 1).
# pick_primary/heir: answered by bridge/include/played_line.h (bridge/test/test_played_line.cpp, ctest); the meter
# reads the bridge's decision (line_watch.h) and keeps no copy of it. Expected values follow from the RULE
# (bridge_init.cpp check_controlled_handoff, as written before METERLINE), not from either half.
#   pick_primary  <id:tier,...> in held order ("-" = nothing held); tier -1 = the title did not look up
#   heir          <raw holder>,<dead id>  (raw holder as the title object carries it, unmasked)
#                 R(t) of a FOLLOWED line character (read alive this sample). Answered by
#                 ctest counts these rows and leaves them to the meter. Keys from the emitter
#                 realm_total_counties_unresolved only when > 0). Owner ruling 2026-11-11: alive,
#                 readable and holding no realm is a real zero; an ENDED line never reaches this read
#                 (realm_growth scores it: R = 0, measured, flag line_ended).
#   line_end      <cached primary>,<raw holder>,<successor found 0/1>,<dead's titles held now>  -> 1 ended / 0 not
#                 THE END DECISION (owner ruling 2026-11-12): bridge/include/line_watch.h line_ended (ctest
#                 test_played_line) and its mirror scripts/study0_fixture_world.py line_ended
#                 (scripts/test_played_line.py). raw holder as HOLDER_CHAR_ID carries it: 0xFFFFFFFF nobody,
#                 0 the title did not look up; titles held -1 = unreadable.
#                 THE HANDOFF'S REALM GUARD (owner ruling 2026-11-12; v3reg2 s3 D1 moved onto Carloman):
